mapper.sql: u.upld_id, u.form_type_cd, u.file_nm, u.upld_stat_cd, c.code_nm AS status_name, u.succ_cnt, u.warn_cnt, u.err_cnt, u.mod_dttm
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_SY_UPLD u JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.code_grp_id='UPLD_STAT' AND c.code=u.upld_stat_cd WHERE u.upld_id=#{uploadId} AND u.form_type_cd='B7'
SELECT FROM TB_SY_UPLD u JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.code_grp_id='UPLD_STAT' AND c.code=u.upld_stat_cd WHERE u.upld_id=#{uploadId} AND u.form_type_cd='B7' FOR UPDATE OF u
SELECT e.row_no, e.col_nm, e.input_val, e.rsn_cn, CASE e.rslt_type_cd WHEN 'ERR' THEN '오류' ELSE '경고' END AS severity FROM TB_SY_UPLD_ERR e WHERE e.upld_id=#{uploadId} ORDER BY e.rslt_sn
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SY_UPLD (upld_id, form_type_cd, scrn_id, file_nm, file_size, tot_row_cnt, succ_cnt, warn_cnt, err_cnt, upld_stat_cd, reg_user_id, reg_dttm) VALUES (#{uploadId}, #{formTypeCode}, 'UI-15', #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{inspection.totalCount}, #{inspection.successCount}, #{inspection.warningCount}, #{inspection.errorCount}, 'CHECKED', 'admin', clock_timestamp())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SY_UPLD SET tot_row_cnt=#{inspection.totalCount}, succ_cnt=#{inspection.successCount}, warn_cnt=#{inspection.warningCount}, err_cnt=#{inspection.errorCount}, upld_stat_cd='APPLIED''CHECKED', aply_dttm=clock_timestamp()NULL, mod_user_id='admin', mod_dttm=GREATEST(clock_timestamp(), COALESCE(mod_dttm,reg_dttm) + INTERVAL '1 microsecond') WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SY_UPLD_ERR (upld_id, rslt_sn, rslt_type_cd, row_no, col_nm, input_val, rsn_cn, reg_user_id, reg_dttm) VALUES (#{uploadId}, #{sequence}, CASE WHEN #{issue.severity}='오류' THEN 'ERR' ELSE 'WARN' END, #{issue.row}, #{issue.column}, #{issue.inputValue}, #{issue.reason}, 'admin', clock_timestamp())
